Running Python code interactively: import subprocess, pathlib, os, re
base='/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/espeak-ng'
print(subprocess.run(['git','-C',base,'log','--oneline','-5'],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).stdout)
print(subprocess.run(['git','-C',base,'status','--short'],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout)
# grep heap likely areas
patterns=['xml_buf','ProcessSsmlTag','N_XML_BUF','ssml_stack','n_ssml_stack','param_stack','str\[','memcpy','memcmp','strlen']
for pat in patterns:
    print('\nPAT',pat)
    out=subprocess.run(['grep','-RIn',pat,base+'/src/libespeak-ng'],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).stdout
    print('\n'.join(out.splitlines()[:80]))
